buildCommand: pnpm --filter=@vms/shared run build && pnpm --filter=@vms/web run build && mkdir -p .vercel/output/static && cp -R apps/web/dist/* .vercel/output/static/ && echo '{"version": 3, "routes": [{"handle": "filesystem"}, {"src": "/(.*)", "dest": "/index.html"}]}' > .vercel/output/config.json
